faqs.card:
Is this compatible with MT4 and MT5?
Yes. The system works with both MT4 and MT5 accounts. Simply connect your account and everything runs automatically.
faqs.question: Is this compatible with MT4 and MT5?

faqs.card:
What is the minimum deposit to get started?
It depends on your plan:

• Free Plan — minimum $10
• Pro Plan — minimum $500
• Elite Plan — minimum $1,000

The Free plan is the easiest way to start. A higher balance means larger position sizes and bigger returns in dollar terms.
faqs.question: What is the minimum deposit to get started?

faqs.card:
How does the AI decide when to trade?
The system analyzes real-time market conditions including news, volatility, trend, spread, and session timing. It then generates a score (0–100) to guide trading decisions.
faqs.question: How does the AI decide when to trade?

faqs.card:
What do the risk levels mean?
The system automatically adjusts trading based on market conditions:

• Low Risk — Aggressive
• Normal Risk — Moderate
• High Risk — Conservative
• Extreme Risk — Off
faqs.question: What do the risk levels mean?

faqs.card:
Why does the system sometimes stop trading?
Trading is paused automatically during high-risk conditions such as major news events or unstable markets to protect your capital.
faqs.question: Why does the system sometimes stop trading?

faqs.card:
How much can I earn per month?
Estimated daily targets by plan (gold trades Mon–Fri only, 22 trading days/month):

• Free — up to 2%/day → up to 44%/month
• Pro — up to 5%/day → up to 110%/month
• Elite — up to 10%/day → up to 220%/month

Example at $1,000 balance: Free = up to $440/month · Pro = up to $1,100/month · Elite = up to $2,200/month. These are estimated targets — actual results depend on live market conditions.
faqs.question: How much can I earn per month?

faqs.card:
Do I need trading experience?
No. The system is fully automated and handles analysis, decision-making, and execution for you.
faqs.question: Do I need trading experience?

faqs.card:
Can I test with a demo account?
Yes. You can test the system using a demo account before switching to a live account.
faqs.question: Can I test with a demo account?

faqs.card:
Are the results shown on the website real?
Yes. Results reflect real trading performance. However, past performance does not guarantee future results.
faqs.question: Are the results shown on the website real?

faqs.card:
What is the difference between Free, Pro, and Elite?
The key differences are daily profit targets and trading channels:

• Free — up to 2%/day · Wallet only · up to $5,000 balance
• Pro — up to 5%/day · Wallet + 1 MT4/MT5 account · up to $20,000 balance
• Elite — up to 10%/day · Wallet + 2 MT4/MT5 accounts · Unlimited balance

All plans charge 0% fee — you keep 100% of every profitable trade.
faqs.question: What is the difference between Free, Pro, and Elite?
